description: The drop-in path is total and idempotent. A bare file whose name is not a slug is adopted, renamed to content/concepts/<slug>.md, its original stem recorded in aliases with warning AGSC-E506, the title taken from the first ATX heading, and the operator taken from bundle.operator in the configuration — no error is possible. Running init a second time changes nothing, because the file now carries a closed frontmatter block and the body bytes were preserved exactly.

type: concept

aliases:

prov:

  operator: human:andreibesleaga
kind: explainer
---

Body stays, byte for byte.
